observations: Torah #98 is a compressed 5-line teaching that does not generate any new package types beyond what is already established in the cross-Torah framework. The teaching organizes entirely around two well-established conceptual poles: (1) the Tzaddik/Tzaddik's-vision cluster (a recognized package type appearing in many Torahs — e.g., Torah #9 Package 3, Torah #1 Package 1 where חכמה/divine perception anchors the good cluster), and (2) the sin/concealment/punishment cluster (the evil mirror, also a recognized type across Torahs). The novel element of Torah #98 — the specific bechina between 'עֵינֵי ה'' and the Tzaddik, and the linguistic reading of 'גַּל' as הִתְגַּלּוּת and 'עֲצָמוֹת' as עוֹצֵם עֵינָיו — are enrichments WITHIN existing package types, not new domains. No third cluster emerges. No cross-cutting domain of 3+ concepts appears that would require a new package category. The teaching's entire structure is a two-pole good/evil mirror: [divine vision → revelation] vs. [self-blinding → forced revelation as punishment]. This is cleanly covered by the existing framework. The Tzaddik-eyes concept could potentially link to the broader cross-Torah concept of עֵינֵי ה' (which also appears in several other LM1 Torahs as a concept), but that is a cross-Torah traversal observation, not a new package type within Torah #98.
